evidence: Changes fuzz harnesses and test utilities in src/test/fuzz/ and src/test/util/ to support block filter index initialization.
rationale: Extends fuzz harnesses to cover previously untested P2P message processing paths. As noted in the description, 'BIP157 P2P messages are not covered by any fuzz targets at all', and enabling them immediately surfaced a UBSan runtime issue in net_processing. Expanding fuzz coverage over P2P message handling is explicitly high-priority within test infrastructure.
